checks.label: Read the returned tracks
checks.success: Confirm the prints match the missing watch and were made by something walking toward Hearthford.
checks.failure: A broken watch badge and the gate ledger still point east; no route is lost.

checks.label: Claim to be lawful relief
checks.success: The sentries salute, allow passage, and repeat HOLD SIX UNTIL RELIEVED.
checks.failure: They demand one weapon as surety; refusal starts combat.

checks.label: Slip through the hedge
checks.success: Bypass the sentries and reach the camp or muster field.
checks.failure: Combat begins with the party 30 feet from the sentries.

checks.label: Read wear on the duty pegs
checks.success: Solve the tag order immediately: Dawn, Noon, Dusk, Midnight, Relief, Return.
checks.failure: After two wrong attempts the box opens anyway, but the first horn sounds and prepared advantage is lost.

checks.label: Repair the broken oath
checks.ability: Strength (Athletics), Dexterity (Sleight of Hand), or Intelligence (Arcana or Religion)
checks.success: Gain 1 repair success; 3 before 2 failures restores the old defensive oath.
checks.failure: Gain 1 repair failure; at 2 failures this method closes unless the party changes approach.

checks.label: Declare lawful relief
checks.success: The captain accepts relief and the dead company stands down forever.
checks.failure: The captain refuses this wording; another method remains available. DC becomes 12 if the roster or rubbing is presented.

checks.label: Offer a new watch oath
checks.success: The dead accept a new-moon promise and free the six now.
checks.failure: They demand a different resolution; repair, release, or breaking the stone remains possible.

encounters.objective: Pass the old sentries by talk, stealth, or force.
encounters.start: Three sentries block the 15-foot road 30 feet ahead and demand the name of the relieving watch.
encounters.bypass: DC 13 Persuasion as relief, DC 13 group Stealth through hedge, or present a credible duty order.

creatures.name: Oathbound Sentry
creatures.attack: Spear. Melee or Ranged +4 to hit; 1d6+2 piercing.
creatures.trait: Formation Guard (reaction, once per round per group). When an adjacent sentry is hit, add +2 AC to that sentry against the triggering attack, potentially turning it into a miss.
creatures.tactics: Hold the road in a line. Do not chase toward Hearthford. Stop immediately if lawfully relieved.

encounters.end: Passage is open when the sentries yield, are bypassed, or are defeated. The last sentry yields when the other two fall.

encounters.objective: Free six captives and resolve the oath; combat occurs only if the stone is broken or talks collapse.
encounters.start: Captain starts 20 feet north of the stone; two sentries start 15 feet east and west. Six captives kneel in a 15-foot ring.
encounters.bypass: Repair (3 successes), lawful release, or a new oath ends the crisis without combat.

creatures.name: Captain of the Last Watch
creatures.attack: Longsword. Melee +5 to hit; 1d8+3 slashing plus 1d4 necrotic. Multiattack: two Longsword attacks.
creatures.action: Command the Line (Recharge 5–6). Each allied Oathbound Sentry moves up to half speed without provoking opportunity attacks.
creatures.tactics: Protect the stone and captives, attack whoever damages the stone, and accept lawful relief if proved. Yield at 10 HP if offered relief.

creatures.name: Oathbound Sentry
creatures.tactics: Stay between the captain and attackers; do not attack captives.

encounters.end: The encounter ends when repair reaches 3 successes, the captain accepts relief/bargain, or the hostile dead are defeated. The six are then free.

hazards.trigger: Lift the duty roster without pinning the black wax seal.
hazards.failure: 2d6 psychic damage and deafened until the end of the character’s next turn.
hazards.success: Half damage and no deafened condition.
hazards.failForward: The dispatch box opens normally and all required clues remain available.

rewards.when: All six missing watchfolk return alive.
rewards.reward: Recovered silver watch-badge worth 50 gp, presented as an honor or kept as treasure.

features: hedges east and west grant half cover
ditches beside road are difficult terrain
sentries start 30 ft. north of party
low south wall grants half cover
